structured_output.notes: Zero third-party dependencies used. Implemented responsive layout with mobile-first adaptivity, HTML5 drag-and-drop, inline title editing, explicit transition buttons, deletion with confirmation, banner notifications for success/error states, and periodic health checks against /health.
structured_output.summary: Implemented the complete MiniBoard web frontend in web/index.html, web/style.css, and web/app.js featuring responsive Kanban board with TODO, DOING, and DONE columns, task creation, inline title editing, drag-and-drop and button-based status transitions, task deletion, and notification handling interfacing with /api/tasks.
